name: Browserbase
description: Cloud browser automation via Browserbase. Create headless browser sessions, run AI web agents, persist login contexts, fetch and search the web, and invoke serverless browser functions. 'Open a browser session and give me the live view link' or 'Run an agent to extract pricing from example.com'.

tools.name: get_project_usage
tools.description: Get a project's browser minutes and proxy usage

tools.name: create_session
tools.description: Create a cloud browser session (billed, 1-minute minimum)

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List sessions, optionally filtered by status or metadata

tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Get a session's status and connect URL

tools.name: get_session_debug_urls
tools.description: Get live-view and debugger URLs for a session

tools.name: get_session_logs
tools.description: Get CDP-level logs for a session

tools.name: get_session_replays
tools.description: List replayable pages captured in a session

tools.name: get_session_replay_playlist
tools.description: Get the m3u8 replay playlist for a session page

tools.name: request_session_recording_downloads
tools.description: Request MP4 assembly for a session's recording

tools.name: get_session_recording_downloads
tools.description: Check MP4 recording download status and signed URLs

tools.name: upload_session_file
tools.description: Upload a workspace-sandboxed local file into a session

tools.name: create_context
tools.description: Create a persistent browser context (cookies, storage)

tools.name: create_agent
tools.description: Create a reusable web agent with a system prompt

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get an agent's prompt and result schema

tools.name: update_agent
tools.description: Update an agent's name, prompt, or result schema

tools.name: delete_agent
tools.description: Delete an agent (existing runs are unaffected)

tools.name: create_agent_run
tools.description: Start an agent run on a task (ad-hoc or with an agent)

tools.name: get_agent_run
tools.description: Get a run's status and result

tools.name: wait_for_agent_run
tools.description: Poll a run until it finishes and return the result

tools.name: get_download_file
tools.description: Fetch a downloaded file as base64 (8MB cap)

tools.name: upload_certificate
tools.description: Upload a CA certificate for proxy use

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch a URL server-side (raw, markdown, or structured JSON)

tools.name: get_function_version
tools.description: Get a function version's params schema

tools.name: list_function_invocations
tools.description: List invocations of a function version

tools.name: get_function_invocation
tools.description: Get an invocation's status and results

tools.name: get_function_build
tools.description: Get a build's status and cause
